```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
    -- Base: direct children of FR-M63S-38
    SELECT 
        c.child_code,
        c.qty AS total_qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_code = 'FR-M63S-38'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: children of children
    SELECT 
        c.child_code,
        b.total_qty * c.qty
    FROM bom b
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = b.child_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT SUM(b.total_qty) AS total_qty
FROM bom b
JOIN product p ON p.product_number = b.child_code
WHERE b.child_code = 'MS-2341'
  AND p.make_flag = FALSE;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get the product_number for part PA-632U
part_info AS (
    SELECT product_number
    FROM product
    WHERE product_number = 'PA-632U'
),
-- Get all orders from Australia in 2025
australia_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.country_code = 'AU'
      AND so.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < '2026-01-01'
),
-- Recursive CTE to compute BOM explosion for each order line
-- We need to find all components at any level, with their total quantity per unit of the root product
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct children of the ordered product
    SELECT 
        ao.order_id,
        ao.order_date,
        ao.product_id,
        ao.order_qty,
        p.product_number AS root_code,
        c.product_number AS item_code,
        uc.qty AS qty_per_unit,
        1 AS level
    FROM australia_orders ao
    JOIN product p ON ao.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN u_composition uc ON p.product_number = uc.parent_code
    JOIN product c ON uc.child_code = c.product_number
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= ao.order_date
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= ao.order_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: children of children
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        be.product_id,
        be.order_qty,
        be.root_code,
        c.product_number AS item_code,
        be.qty_per_unit * uc.qty AS qty_per_unit,
        be.level + 1
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN u_composition uc ON be.item_code = uc.parent_code
    JOIN product c ON uc.child_code = c.product_number
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= be.order_date
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= be.order_date)
)
-- Sum up all demand for part PA-632U
SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN be.item_code = (SELECT product_number FROM part_info) 
            THEN be.order_qty * be.qty_per_unit 
            ELSE 0 
        END
    ), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN p.product_number = (SELECT product_number FROM part_info) 
            THEN ao.order_qty 
            ELSE 0 
        END
    ), 0) AS total_demand
FROM australia_orders ao
LEFT JOIN product p ON ao.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN bom_explosion be ON ao.order_id = be.order_id AND ao.product_id = be.product_id;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get the product_number for the target part
target_part AS (
    SELECT product_number
    FROM product
    WHERE product_number = 'CR-7833'
),
-- Get all orders from Canada in 2022
canada_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.country_code = 'CA'
      AND so.order_date >= '2022-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < '2023-01-01'
),
-- Recursive CTE to compute BOM explosion for each order line product
-- We need to find all components at any level, with their total quantity per unit of the root
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct children of the ordered product
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.order_date,
        co.product_id,
        co.order_qty,
        p.product_number AS root_code,
        c.product_number AS item_code,
        uc.qty AS qty_per_unit
    FROM canada_orders co
    JOIN product p ON co.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN u_composition uc ON p.product_number = uc.parent_code
    JOIN product c ON uc.child_code = c.product_number
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= co.order_date
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= co.order_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: children of children
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        be.product_id,
        be.order_qty,
        be.root_code,
        c.product_number AS item_code,
        be.qty_per_unit * uc.qty AS qty_per_unit
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN u_composition uc ON be.item_code = uc.parent_code
    JOIN product c ON uc.child_code = c.product_number
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= be.order_date
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= be.order_date)
)
-- Sum up all demand for the target part
SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN be.item_code = tp.product_number THEN be.order_qty * be.qty_per_unit
            ELSE 0
        END
    ), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN p.product_number = tp.product_number THEN co.order_qty
            ELSE 0
        END
    ), 0) AS total_demand
FROM canada_orders co
JOIN product p ON co.product_id = p.product_id
CROSS JOIN target_part tp
LEFT JOIN bom_explosion be ON co.order_id = be.order_id AND co.product_id = be.product_id
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
bom_edges AS (
    SELECT
        c.parent_code,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.valid_from <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2025-06-30')
),
bom_paths AS (
    -- Base: direct children
    SELECT
        parent_code AS root_code,
        child_code AS item_code,
        qty AS path_qty,
        valid_from,
        valid_to
    FROM bom_edges

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursive: extend paths through manufactured children
    SELECT
        bp.root_code,
        be.child_code,
        bp.path_qty * be.qty,
        GREATEST(bp.valid_from, be.valid_from),
        CASE
            WHEN bp.valid_to IS NULL AND be.valid_to IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN bp.valid_to IS NULL THEN be.valid_to
            WHEN be.valid_to IS NULL THEN bp.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(bp.valid_to, be.valid_to)
        END
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN bom_edges be ON bp.item_code = be.parent_code
    JOIN product p ON p.product_number = bp.item_code
    WHERE p.make_flag = TRUE
),
-- Aggregate qty per root, item, and validity interval
bom_agg AS (
    SELECT
        root_code,
        item_code,
        SUM(path_qty) AS total_qty,
        valid_from,
        valid_to
    FROM bom_paths
    GROUP BY root_code, item_code, valid_from, valid_to

    FROM nw_orders nw

)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get the product_number for part MB-6061
part_info AS (
    SELECT product_number
    FROM product
    WHERE product_number = 'MB-6061'
),
-- Get all orders from Canada in 2022
canada_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.country_code = 'CA'
      AND so.order_date >= '2022-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < '2023-01-01'
),
-- Recursive CTE to compute total quantity of MB-6061 in each product's BOM
-- Base case: direct composition edges
bom_recursive AS (
    -- Direct children
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.order_date,
        p.product_number AS root_code,
        c.product_number AS item_code,
        uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM canada_orders co
    JOIN product p ON co.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN u_composition uc ON p.product_number = uc.parent_code
    JOIN product c ON uc.child_code = c.product_number
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= co.order_date
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= co.order_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: go deeper into BOM
    SELECT 
        br.order_id,
        br.order_date,
        br.root_code,
        c.product_number AS item_code,
        br.total_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom_recursive br
    JOIN u_composition uc ON br.item_code = uc.parent_code
    JOIN product c ON uc.child_code = c.product_number
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= br.order_date
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= br.order_date)
)
-- Sum up all demand for MB-6061
SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN br.item_code = (SELECT product_number FROM part_info) 
            THEN br.total_qty * co.order_qty 
            ELSE 0 
        END
    ), 0) + 
    COALESCE(SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN p.product_number = (SELECT product_number FROM part_info) 
            THEN co.order_qty 
            ELSE 0 
        END
    ), 0) AS total_demand
FROM canada_orders co
LEFT JOIN product p ON co.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN bom_recursive br ON co.order_id = br.order_id AND co.order_date = br.order_date;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
bom_edges AS (
    SELECT
        c.parent_code,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.valid_from <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2025-06-30')
),
bom_paths AS (
    -- Base: direct children
    SELECT
        parent_code AS root_code,
        child_code AS item_code,
        qty AS path_qty,
        valid_from,
        valid_to
    FROM bom_edges

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursive: extend paths through manufactured children
    SELECT
        bp.root_code,
        be.child_code,
        bp.path_qty * be.qty,
        GREATEST(bp.valid_from, be.valid_from),
        CASE
            WHEN bp.valid_to IS NULL AND be.valid_to IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN bp.valid_to IS NULL THEN be.valid_to
            WHEN be.valid_to IS NULL THEN bp.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(bp.valid_to, be.valid_to)
        END
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN bom_edges be ON bp.item_code = be.parent_code
    JOIN product p ON p.product_number = bp.item_code
    WHERE p.make_flag = TRUE
),
-- Aggregate qty per root-item pair for a given date
bom_qty_on_date AS (
    SELECT
        root_code,
        item_code,
        SUM(path_qty) AS total_qty
    FROM bom_paths
    WHERE valid_from <= '2023-12-31'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= '2023-01-01')
    GROUP BY root_code, item_code
),
-- Get Southwest territory ID
sw_territory AS (
    SELECT territory_id
    FROM sales_territory
    WHERE territory_group = 'Southwest'
),
-- Orders in Southwest in 2023
sw_orders AS (
    SELECT
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN sw_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE so.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= '2023-12-31'
),
-- Direct sales of RW-M928
direct_demand AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(o.order_qty) AS direct_units
    FROM sw_orders o
    JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'RW-M928'
),
-- Contained demand: for each order line, sum BOM qty of RW-M928 in that product
contained_demand AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(o.order_qty * bq.total_qty) AS contained_units
    FROM sw_orders o
    JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN bom_qty_on_date bq ON bq.root_code = p.product_number
    WHERE bq.item_code = 'RW-M928'
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(d.direct_units, 0) + COALESCE(c.contained_units, 0) AS total_demand
FROM direct_demand d
CROSS JOIN contained_demand c;
```

```sql
    FROM bom_edges

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursive: extend paths through manufactured children
    SELECT
        bp.root_code,
        be.child_code,
        bp.path_qty * be.qty,
        GREATEST(bp.valid_from, be.valid_from),
        CASE
            WHEN bp.valid_to IS NULL AND be.valid_to IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN bp.valid_to IS NULL THEN be.valid_to
            WHEN be.valid_to IS NULL THEN bp.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(bp.valid_to, be.valid_to)
        END
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN bom_edges be ON bp.item_code = be.parent_code
    JOIN product p ON p.product_number = bp.item_code
    WHERE p.make_flag = TRUE
),
-- Aggregate BOM quantities per root, item, and validity interval
bom_agg AS (
    SELECT
        root_code,
        item_code,
        valid_from,
        valid_to,
        SUM(path_qty) AS total_qty
    FROM bom_paths
    GROUP BY root_code, item_code, valid_from, valid_to
),
-- Get orders from Northwest territory in 2024
nw_orders AS (
    SELECT
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Northwest'
      AND so.order_date >= '2024-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < '2025-01-01'
),
-- Direct sales of FK-9939
direct_demand AS (

    FROM nw_orders nw
    JOIN product p ON nw.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'FK-9939'

-- Contained demand: FK-9939 as component in other products sold

    FROM nw_orders nw
    JOIN product p ON nw.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN bom_agg ba ON p.product_number = ba.root_code
    WHERE ba.item_code = 'FK-9939'

)
SELECT

    COALESCE((SELECT contained_units FROM contained_demand), 0) AS total_demand
```

```sql
    WHERE so.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < '2024-01-01'
),
-- Recursive CTE to compute BOM explosion for each order line
-- We need to find all paths from the sold product down to FR-R92R-62
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct children of the sold product
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.order_date,
        o.product_id AS root_product_id,
        o.order_qty,
        p.product_number AS root_code,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty AS path_qty,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM canada_2023_orders o
    JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN u_composition c ON p.product_number = c.parent_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= o.order_date
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= o.order_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: children of children
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.order_date,
        be.root_product_id,
        be.order_qty,
        be.root_code,
        c.child_code,
        be.path_qty * c.qty AS path_qty,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN u_composition c ON be.child_code = c.parent_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= be.order_date
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= be.order_date)
)

    SUM(be.order_qty * be.path_qty) AS total_demand
FROM bom_explosion be
```

```sql
    JOIN product_category c    ON c.category_id = s.category_id

    SELECT parent_code, child_code
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= valid_to)

reach(root_code, item_code) AS (

    JOIN edges e ON e.parent_code = r.item_code

WHERE item_code = 'SE-T924'
ORDER BY product_number;
```
